title: Missing Surgical Implant Proof & Packaging Barcode
description: Surgical implant or prosthetic device billed without verified manufacturer invoice, batch number, or packaging barcode sticker.

required_documents.description: Official manufacturer tax invoice with itemized serial and lot number
Sterile packaging outer barcode sticker affixed to operation theater register
Surgeon intraoperative note detailing size, placement, and fixation technique

appeal_rationale_template: Implant verification packet attached comprising original manufacturer invoice, packaging barcode sticker, and intraoperative placement records validating medical necessity and authentic procurement.

title: Missing Histopathology / Biopsy Confirmation
description: Surgical excision or organ resection billed without specimen histopathology examination report.

required_documents.description: NABL-accredited laboratory histopathology examination report confirming acute pathology
Operation room nurse specimen handover logbook entry

appeal_rationale_template: NABL laboratory histopathology report attached demonstrating histological verification of acute inflammation and justifying surgical resection.

title: Inpatient Admission Medical Necessity Verification
description: Inpatient hospitalization queried as investigation-only or conservative care without clinical indication for continuous parenteral therapy.

required_documents.description: Intensive monitoring flowsheet demonstrating hemodynamic instability or high fever spikes
Daily laboratory trend sheets (e.g. Platelet drop, elevated Hematocrit, renal markers)
Nursing administration record for continuous parenteral fluids and IV antibiotics

appeal_rationale_template: Serial laboratory reports and intensive nursing flowsheet attached confirming acute hemodynamic decompensation requiring continuous inpatient parenteral intervention.

title: Unbundled Procedure Clinical Differentiation
description: Component service flagged as mutually bundled under primary surgical package (Rule CR-003).

required_documents.description: Comprehensive operative notes proving separate anatomical incision, distinct surgical pathology, or severe adhesiolysis exceeding 45 minutes
Treating consultant surgeon certificate providing clinical justification for independent procedure

appeal_rationale_template: Treating surgeon certificate and operative record attached demonstrating distinct anatomical field and exceptional surgical pathology justifying independent component billing under clinical guidelines.

title: Pre-Existing Disease (PED) Waiting Period Refutation
description: Claim rejected under 24-month specific illness waiting period clause or pre-existing disease exclusion.

required_documents.description: Initial emergency room / OPD consultation record documenting acute de-novo onset without prior medical history
Declaration by treating physician confirming no prior symptomatic manifestation before policy inception

appeal_rationale_template: Emergency initial consultation notes and attending physician statement attached verifying sudden acute manifestation with zero prior clinical history, refuting pre-existing condition classification.
